text: Explain why database indexes make searching records faster.
originalAnswer: An index provides a lookup structure so a query can avoid scanning every row.

text: Describe how a database index speeds up finding rows.
answer: The lookup structure narrows the set of rows read for a query.

text: Explain how encryption keeps a private message unreadable without a key.
answer: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext that requires a suitable key to decrypt.
originalAnswer: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext that requires a suitable key to decrypt.

text: Describe how encrypting messages protects their contents with secret keys.
answer: A cipher uses a key to turn readable data into ciphertext; decryption reverses it.
